cues: And crucially, a monocot root has no cambium, so it shows no secondary growth.
A dicot root has a cambium in waiting, formed later from the conjunctive tissue and the pericycle.
text: And crucially, a monocot root has no cambium, so it shows no secondary growth. A dicot root has a cambium in waiting, formed later from the conjunctive tissue and the pericycle.
